reviews.title: Coolest fans. haha get it.
reviews.comment: These fans are so nice. The RGB function of these bad boys is crazy good! The time warp profile is so cool, looks like they're off. iCUE software is basic enough and easily navigated. I haven't had any troubles. The cables could stand to be a little longer. Just like a handful more mm's. Pretty awesome they connect together and they are controlled through one little docking chinga. Really cleans up the cable clutter. They start to get noisy at around 800rpm. And by noisy I mean you can barely start to hear them. Max RPM that I have got was around 2400rpm and they are screaming at that power. My PC has a 9800x3d and a 5070ti and temps haven't gone above 60c. If you're looking for rgb fans that have crazy amounts of controllability these are for you. Even if there are cheaper options out there. You wont be disappointed in these bad boys.

reviews.title: Well worth the money spent
reviews.comment: Quality vs price, it's still a win. Granted these are not the cheapest fans available, not are they the most beautiful fans available. What they are is a high quality efficient fan with little to no noise and outstanding cooling capabilities. These fans run at less speed to cool my 9950x3d easily. Reversed fans to keep things attractively flowing through my rig while providing outstanding cooling capabilities. Just the right amount of RGB for a beautiful build while keeping the heat monster at bay. One cable to attach 8 fans daisy chained while still being able to address each fan individually is just incredible. I absolutely love this set up. I tried these and the qx icue link fans and could not stand the qx series. These hands down blow those qx series fans out of the water. Corsair nailed it with this design. My rig specs: 3500x case Auros 879e pro board, 9950x3d chip 64 gig Vengeance 3cl times at 6200mhz 7900xtx GPU Titan 360 aio 3 reverse 120s for intake 3 standard 120s for radiator 1 140 reversed for intake 1000 EVGA PSU Love it!

reviews.title: A Smooth Setup and Great Performance
reviews.comment: I recently upgraded my PC with the CORSAIR iCUE Link LX120-R RGB 120mm 3-Fan Pack, and I’m genuinely impressed. The fans are sleek and stylish, with a reverse rotor design that keeps the RGB lighting visible even when mounted as intake fans . The dual light loops create smooth, synchronized lighting effects that really enhance the look of my build. Installation was a breeze. The iCUE Link system uses a single cable to connect all components, reducing cable clutter and simplifying the setup process. The included iCUE Link System Hub allows for easy management of up to seven devices per port, and the reversible cables make connecting components straightforward . Performance-wise, the fans are quiet and efficient. They operate at a noise level ranging from 10 to 38 dBA and can reach speeds up to 2400 RPM, providing a good balance between airflow and noise . The magnetic dome bearing ensures low friction and contributes to the fans' quiet operation. One thing to note is that the iCUE Link system is not backward compatible with older Corsair controllers, so you’ll need to use the included hub and cables . The CORSAIR iCUE Link LX120-R RGB 120mm 3-Fan Pack is a solid choice for anyone looking to enhance their PC's aesthetics and cooling performance. The easy installation, clean design, and reliable performance make it a worthwhile investment.
reviews.author: Alex
